title: 국회의원수당 등에 관한 규칙 / queue:ARTICLE:2:0:00002:part:1/1
full_text: Article 2 (Standards for Payment and Adjustment of Allowances) Monthly allowances for members of the National Assembly shall be paid according to the standards specified in Appendix 1 until the Act is amended: Provided, That where the Speaker of the National Assembly deems it necessary to adjust allowances before these Rules are amended, the Speaker may determine the adjustments within the scope of the adjustment rate of remuneration for public officials.
